title: Glad to forget hardships at home
summary: Asked about keeping up with America, he says he was happy to be out of the hardships of his homeland.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

No. I was glad to forget it.
I was glad to forget it.
No, things weren't like the other day. You know, in America, the black man has come a long way in forty years.
You see. And some of the hardships and all that we had, we were happy to say we were out of it. And at one time --
